title: Tools manifest
description: Mapping of tool names (keys) to their metadata objects.

additionalProperties.description: Metadata for a single CLI tool or binary.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the tool does.

download_url.description: Template URL used to download the tool's release artifact (may contain placeholders like {{version}} or {{os}}).

license.description: License identifier or text describing the tool's software license.

repo_url.description: URL of the tool's source code repository, typically on a hosting service like GitHub.

version.description: Version string of the tool to install or reference (e.g. semantic version).
